blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla said he was open to a dialogue with representatives of the True Brown Style (TBS) gang but stressed that any talks should include a commitment to stop what he described as the group’s criminal activities. “A dialogue must be with a commitment to stopping their nefarious activities,” Remulla said in an ambush interview on Thursday. READ: DILG goes after crime gang recruiting minors He also stressed that law enforcement agencies would continue enforcing the law against TBS members, saying reconciliation could not happen without justice and truth.
